reviews.title: it works, but read more
reviews.comment: if you want a mouse that could butterfly click, you would do good in buying a model o. However, if you want to buy this mouse because you need something that could drag click, i wouldn’t recommend it. This mouse works fine, but for some reason it’s INCREDIBLY hard to drag click on it, and it’s near impossible to do it without tape. The only way i managed to do it was by putting double sided tape on the mouse and using the friction from that. If you want a drag click mouse, i recommend the Bloody A70 (this mouse also gets more cps when butterflying), but if you want something that could cleanly butterfly click, go with this one.
